items.title: CHD Q3 deep dive: innovation, productivity, and brand strength shape outlook amid inflationary pressures
items.summary: Household products company Church & Dwight (NYSE:CHD) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 1% year on year to $1.60 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.64 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.92 per share was 2.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
